breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: X-linked form of disease.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A angiodysplasia that involves the intestine.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of fibroblasts. It is characterized by collagen production and a herringbone architectural pattern. master.name_en: rhabdomyosarcoma with mixed embryonal and alveolar features
master.definition_en: A rhabdomyosarcoma composed of embryonic and alveolar components. It is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with myoblastic differentiation, a myxoid stroma, and fibrous septa. These tumors were previously considered variants of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma. The lack of PAX3-FOXO1 fusions in most of these tumors suggests that are biologically and clinically related to embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.
synonyms_en: rhabdomyosarcoma with mixed embryonal and alveolar features

master.definition_en: An erythropoietic protoporphyria in which the cause of the disease is a hemizygous, heterozygous, or homozygous (rare) gain-of-function (GOF) variant (X-linked inheritance pattern) in the terminal regulatory exon of ALAS2. GOF variants increase ALAS2 activity resulting in pathway upregulation and high levels of protoporphyrin IX (PPIX). Males with hemizygous variants frequently present in early childhood with severe cutaneous photosensitivity and laboratory markers of liver disease. Heterozygous females can present with symptoms ranging from as severe as affected males to asymptomatic due to random X-chromosome inactivation. This disease is clinically indistinguishable from FECH-related erythropoietic protoporphyria.

master.definition_en: A rare X-linked cerebellar ataxia, characterized by a combination of upper and lower motor neuron signs, with an age of onset in the first or second decade, slow progression, and normal intelligence. Typical features of cerebellar dysfunction include gait and limb ataxia, intention tremor, dysmetria, dysdiadochokinesia, dysarthria, nystagmus, and hyperreflexia. Further phenotypic features are pes cavus, scoliosis, muscle atrophy, and peripheral sensory and motor nerve abnormalities.

master.definition_en: An acute bacterial disease caused by Neisseria meningitides that presents usually, but not always, with a rash (non blanching petechial or purpuric rash), progressively developing signs of meningitis (fever, vomiting, headache, photophobia, and neck stiffness) and later leading to confusion, delirium and drowsiness. Neck stiffness and photophobia are often absent in infants and young children who may manifest nonspecific signs such as irritability, inconsolable crying, poor feeding, and a bulging fontanel. Meningococcal meningitis may also present as part of early or late onset sepsis in neonates. The disease is potentially fatal. Surviving patients may develop neurological sequelae that include sensorineural hearing loss, seizures, spasticity, attention deficits and intellectual disability.

curated.category: 急症与罕见高危传染病 (High-Consequence Infectious Disease)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 脑膜炎奈瑟菌经飞沫传播侵入血流及蛛网膜下腔；暴发型流脑（伴脓毒性休克/华-佛综合征）可在起病数小时至24小时内迅猛进展致多器官衰竭与死亡。WHO指出细菌性脑膜炎约1/6病例死亡、1/5幸存者遗留严重神经后遗症。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 极度依赖早期识别与第一时间静脉注射头孢曲松等抗菌药；抗生素配合休克复苏和激素抗脑水肿可显著降低病死率，多价结合疫苗（A/C/Y/W135及B群疫苗）可有效预防。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球死因未单列流脑全年龄汇总条目。GBD 2021估算儿童脑膜炎总死亡约11.2万例，其中脑膜炎奈瑟菌占14.03%；2025年非洲“脑膜炎带”24国累计报告疑似病例21,526例、死亡971例（病死率约4.5%）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 2024年中国国家疾控局法定报告传染病显示，全国全年报告流行性脑脊髓膜炎129例、死亡7例（属乙类重点防控传染病，国内维持低散发但病死率较高）。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 撒哈拉以南非洲“脑膜炎带”旱季仍频发流行；未经治疗病例病死率可高达50%以上。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 得益于免疫规划（A群及A+C群流脑多糖疫苗纳入一类疫苗），国内发病例数已维持在百余例低水平，但W135/Y/B等非免疫规划血清群偶有暴发风险。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 高度疑诊流脑（突发高热、剧烈头痛、喷射性呕吐、皮肤瘀点瘀斑或颈项强直）即刻启动呼吸道隔离并留取血培养（切勿因等待腰穿或影像检查而延迟给药）；第一时间静脉推注足量第三代头孢菌素（如头孢曲松钠2g q12h）；暴发型伴休克及DIC者同步按脓毒性休克液体复苏、去甲肾上腺素升压及早期糖皮质激素减轻脑水肿与休克；密切接触者预防性口服环丙沙星或利福平。
